mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes a slowdown in consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to lower corporate revenues and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both decline, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls below 110, or the Rank IC is below 0.04 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 205 indicates accelerating inflation, which typically leads to expectations of tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 205, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1500 indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as it signals economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1500, or the Rank IC is below 0.05 over 1-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 115 indicates robust supply growth, which typically leads to lower inflation and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 115, or the Rank IC is below 0.04 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market indicated by unemployment below 4.0% and non-farm payrolls above 136000 typically leads to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 136000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year windows.
